medium: Paper-native raster generation and editable Paper labels

sequences.name: Бирюзовая жаровня
sequences.keySequence: Сжатие → рост → раздвоение → выброс → спад → подхват.
sequences.events: Событие: искра на 04. Чаша и опоры неподвижны.

sequences.name: Магентовая жаровня
sequences.keySequence: Развилка → крюк → два пика → завиток → сжатие → рост.
sequences.events: Событие: отрыв уголька на 03. Свой ритм пламени.

sequences.name: Янтарный костёр
sequences.keySequence: Низкое ядро → левый пик → два языка → искры → спад → рост.
sequences.events: Событие: искры на 04. Камни и поленья неподвижны.

review.verdict: Six different flame silhouettes for each palette; fixed vessels, log and stone bases; clear typography, spacing and contrast; numbering aligned.

sequences.name: Открывание ворот
sequences.events: 02: щелчок защёлки. 06: проход открыт. Петли фиксированы.

sequences.name: Святилище
sequences.events: 04: пик свечения и кольцо. Лечение срабатывает сразу на 01; 06: использовано

gameplayHealing.source: User-specified gameplay contract; independent of the visual glow peak

review.verdict: Gate leaves and chest lid articulate across six stages; shrine amber activation peaks and fades; fixed bases and full objects; readable timing and footer.

captionRevision.reason: Separate immediate gameplay healing at key 01 from the visual glow peak at key 04.

sequences.name: Рябь воды
sequences.keySequence: Рождение кольца → расширение → разрыв блика → край → затухание → новый фронт.
sequences.events: 04: новое внутреннее кольцо. Контур воды закреплён.

sequences.name: Полотно на ветру
sequences.keySequence: Тихая складка → порыв → S-изгиб → обратная волна → расслабление → подхват.
sequences.events: 03–04: пик порыва. Крепления неподвижны, хвост запаздывает.

sequences.name: Дрейфующий пепел
sequences.keySequence: Рождение снизу слева → подъём → разворот → рассеивание → угасание → замещение.
sequences.events: Частицы обновляются постепенно. Плита — фиксированный ориентир.

review.verdict: Expanding water rings, changing cloth silhouette and redistributed ash; six stages each; fit-content applied after all labels; lower footer verified in Paper and local export.

timingStatus: Animation durations and visual event timing are proposed. Shrine gameplay healing is +40 immediately at 0 ms (key 01), independent of the visual glow peak at key 04.
deliveryNotes: Three new raster contact sheets generated inside Paper, one generation per sheet.
Native Paper headers, key numbers, sequence labels, proposed timing and event notes remain editable.
All artboards use height: fit-content; final screenshots and local third-board export include the footer.
Original URLs returned by Paper get_fill_image were downloaded unchanged; no CLI/API generation fallback.
Paper export writes its default copies to Downloads; byte-identical copies are delivered in world/exports.
These are storyboard keys, not engine-ready sprite atlases.
limitations: Key drawings require production cleanup, frame extraction, alpha preparation, exact pixel registration and in-engine timing review before runtime use.
Loop direction and proposed timing are documented; seamless playback was not claimed or tested in the engine.
